description: This file contains utility functions for detecting changed file scopes in a Git repository, primarily used for CI/CD workflows. It includes regex patterns for identifying specific file types and paths, functions to list changed files, determine execution scope, and output results to GitHub Actions.

methods.name: detectChangedScope
methods.description: Determines which parts of the project need to be run based on changed file paths.

methods.name: listChangedPaths
methods.description: Uses git to list files changed between two commits or branches.

methods.name: writeGitHubOutput
methods.description: Outputs the scope detection results to a GitHub Actions output file.
